title: Rain data choice changed the sign of a 25-year runoff comparison at nine south-east Australian gauges
abstract: We test whether the full 1997-2021 runoff loss exceeded all earlier losses of the same length. We use nine fixed south-east Australian gauges and 26 earlier 25-year periods within 1947-1996. For each earlier period, one rain model is fitted on the other pre-1997 years and predicts both test periods. With SILO rain, the recent runoff departure was 4.97 points above the closest earlier departure, in 1969-1993. With AGCD rain on the same records, it was 7.39 points below that period and below every earlier comparison. Units are percentage points of fixed baseline mean runoff. Spatial 95% intervals are -2.46 to +10.39 and -14.98 to +1.31. Joint cell and three-year block intervals also include zero. Quadratic and seasonal rain fits retain the opposite sample signs. Gauge and cell omissions do too. An exploratory exact decomposition assigns -15.78 points of the -12.36-point product difference to their different recent-minus-earlier rain contrasts, and +3.42 points to different fitted responses. AGCD has a 57.11 mm/year larger current-rain contrast. This identifies the source of the statistical disagreement, not the better rain product. Five cells, early flow quality, short fits and only two non-overlapping historical periods limit inference. The test compares 25-year means; it does not test continuous annual non-recovery or a causal state shift. Code, external-source hashes, aggregate evidence, all resampling statistics and numerical audits are supplied.

display.caption: Rain products give opposite 25-year comparisons at nine fixed south-east gauges. Each earlier period and 1997-2021 share a rain fit. Bands are pointwise spatial intervals. North is a secondary three-gauge check.
Earlier-period selection is repeated in each draw. Spatial and joint spatial and regional-year intervals describe different uncertainty assumptions.
An exact decomposition at 1969-1993 assigns the product difference to different rain contrasts and fitted responses. This does not show which product is correct.

citations.reason: Its 13-year comparison motivates our full-duration test. Its time and quality conventions inform preparation.
We use its published 27-gauge selection, region and cell labels, request URLs and hashes. We retrieve flow again and build new annual inputs and fits.
It leaves full duration and common-calibration refits open. We address these issues on a smaller fixed panel.
Its rain-product sensitivity also occurs in our full 25-year paired comparison.
It motivates separate spatial and regional-year uncertainty.
Its distinction between loss size and response form limits interpretation of an analogue.
Its persistence result motivates our full-period mean test, a different estimand.
